title: Subsets
description: Given an array of unique integers, return all possible subsets (the power set) without duplicates, in any order.

reference.use_case: Enumerating every combination of a small set of options, such as all on/off combinations of feature flags to test or every bundle of add-ons a customer could choose.
system_examples: Combinatorial configuration testing — exercising every combination of feature flags or build options
Query optimizers (System R-style planners such as PostgreSQL's standard join search) — evaluating subsets of relations when building join orders
Market-basket analysis (Apriori) — generating candidate itemsets of products bought together
reference.explanation: Each element is either in or out, so there are 2ⁿ subsets; backtracking or iterating bitmasks enumerates them in O(n·2ⁿ). Real systems enumerate exhaustively only for small n and otherwise prune, but include/exclude recursion is the base of all of them.
